initiative.title: Graph 3D View — InfraNodus-style 3D knowledge-graph on our stack

mission: Ship an InfraNodus-style React 3D knowledge-graph renderer (community colors, betweenness-proportional distance-faded labels, curved edges, selection dimming) on the cosmos/ontology stack, integrated into the ontology workbench behind a 2D/3D toggle with cosmos 2D default, at ~2,500 interactive nodes.
statusNote: P0 design gate completed 2026-07-16: research/DESIGN.md (v2, post codex adversarial review in research/DESIGN-REVIEW.md) decides all seven gate questions with a 2.5k benchmark (scratchpad/graph-3d-bench, 59-60fps vsync-capped at 2,500 nodes / 5,000-12,500 edges). P1 generic component in progress.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The implementation would exceed named scope.
2,500-node interactive rendering proves infeasible on every candidate stack on the target hardware; record the proven ceiling and report before expanding the appetite.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
